kurals.tr: Karavaadhu Uvandheeyum Kannannaar Kannum / Iravaamai Koti Urum
kurals.m: Not to beg (at all) even from those excellent persons who cheerfully give without refusing, will do immense good

kurals.tr: Irandhum Uyirvaazhdhal Ventin Parandhu / Ketuka Ulakiyatri Yaan
kurals.m: If the Creator of the world has decreed even begging as a means of livelihood, may he too go abegging and perish

kurals.tr: Inmai Itumpai Irandhudheer Vaamennum / Vanmaiyin Vanpaatta Thil
kurals.m: There is no greater folly than the boldness with which one seeks to remedy the evils of poverty by begging (rather than by working)

kurals.tr: Itamellaam Kollaath Thakaiththe Itamillaak / Kaalum Iravollaach Chaalpu
kurals.m: Even the whole world cannot sufficiently praise the dignity that would not beg even in the midst of destitution

kurals.tr: Thenneer Atupurkai Aayinum Thaaldhandhadhu / Unnalin Oonginiya Thil
kurals.m: Even thin gruel is ambrosia to him who has obtained it by labour

kurals.tr: Aavirku Neerendru Irappinum Naavirku / Iravin Ilivandha Thil
kurals.m: There is nothing more disgraceful to one's tongue than to use it in begging water even for a cow

kurals.tr: Irappan Irappaarai Ellaam Irappin / Karappaar Iravanmin Endru
kurals.m: I beseech all beggars and say, "If you need to beg, never beg of those who give unwillingly."

kurals.tr: Iravennum Emaappil Thoni Karavennum / Paardhaakkap Pakku Vitum
kurals.m: The unsafe raft of begging will split when it strikes on the rock of refusal

kurals.tr: Iravulla Ullam Urukum Karavulla / Ulladhooum Indrik Ketum
kurals.m: To think of (the evil of) begging is enough to melt one's heart; but to think of refusal is enough to break it

kurals.tr: Karappavarkku Yaangolikkum Kollo Irappavar / Sollaatap Poom Uyir
kurals.m: Saying "No" to a beggar takes away his life. (but as that very word will kill the refuser) where then would the latter's life hide itself ?
